MissingModel.description: 🕳️ How the native child names a plugin whose component model the launcher has not published yet: a retryable PLUGIN_UNAVAILABLE whose `details` carry the typed cause, the plugin with its crate, and the en + de sentence a client shows (`{pluginId}` is replaced by the plugin). Between the native channel and the tool answer it travels as the `message` of a Fault whose code is `plugin.model-missing`, and every answering path merges its own context into these details instead of replacing them. The launcher's gateway reads exactly this from a relayed response and builds that model once per plugin and session.

summary.en: Plugin `{pluginId}` has no component model yet; the launcher is preparing it, retry in a moment.
summary.de: Das Plugin `{pluginId}` hat noch kein Komponentenmodell; der Starter bereitet es vor, gleich erneut versuchen.

MissingModelDetails.description: The typed cause plus whatever call context the answering tool merged in (job, artifact, kind, field, ...): only the three typed members are closed.
